potential_leakage_warnings: anc_recovered: Neutrophil recovery is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
anc_recovery_day: Day of neutrophil recovery is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
plt_recovered: Platelet recovery is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
plt_recovery_day: Day of platelet recovery is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
agvhd_ii_iv: Acute GvHD II–IV is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
agvhd_iii_iv: Acute GvHD III–IV is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
agvhd_iii_iv_day: Day of acute GvHD III–IV is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
extensive_cgvhd: Extensive chronic GvHD is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
relapse: Relapse is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
follow_up_days: Follow-up is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
died: Died is recorded after Day 0 and would leak the outcome
data_quality_notes: 2 record(s) (UCI-106, UCI-123) are coded as no grade III–IV acute GvHD but carry an onset day; the coded flag is used and the onset day ignored.

Missing pre-transplant values (imputed on the training fold only): recipient_body_mass 2, recipient_abo 1, recipient_rh 2, recipient_cmv 14, donor_cmv 2, abo_mismatched 1, hla_antigen_differences 1, hla_allele_differences 1, cd3_dose 5, cd34_cd3_ratio 5.
